data.raw_text:
Let’s zoom out and look at the macro, 

1/ Iran is affected the most. 40% of state revenue comes from oil. 

2/ China loves Iran’s discounted oil, buying 80–90%+ of what Iran ships out through small, privately-owned “teapot” refineries (independent oil refineries primarily based in Shandong province) in China. The U.S. just sanctioned Hengli Petrochemical, China’s 2nd largest teapot, and blacklisted ~40 shadow fleet ships doing the deliveries. That cheap oil pipeline is now on fire. 

3/ China still needs those barrels. They’re the world’s second largest economy. They’ll go shopping on the open market, chasing Russian, Saudi, and Brazilian crude instead. More buyers, same supply. Prices go up for everyone. Whether you’re in France, Florida, or the Philippines, you’re part of this story too. #OilPrices #Geopolitics

ROADWORKS ADVISORY: PASAY CITY

Maynilad is currently undertaking ongoing construction works along St. Augustine, Pasay City, to improve water service reliability in the area.

Traffic impact:
•One-way (entry-only) traffic is being implemented along the affected stretch
• Possible delays, especially during active work hours

Work schedule:
• Daily from 10:00 PM to 5:00 AM
• Ongoing since April 7, 2026
• Target completion: May 31, 2026 (subject to site conditions)

Traffic management measures are in place in coordination with the Pasay Traffic and Parking Management Office (PTPMO) and concerned barangays. Traffic advisories are posted onsite, and personnel are deployed to assist motorists.

View exact location: https://t.co/6wSuY8fFRg

Motorists are advised to plan trips accordingly and consider alternate routes where possible.

Thank you for your patience as we carry out these necessary improvements.

Police identified firearm brandishing individual in road accident viral video  in Taguig-Makati Border.

Brig. Gen. Rodecindo Reales identified during a press briefing held at Camp Crame, Mr. Joey Sabando, a protection agent which was in the viral video seen brandishing a firearm while ordering the pick-up truck driver to surrender.

Moreover, PNP spokesperson, Brig. Gen. Randulf Tuaño said also during the press briefing that the protection agent surrendered voluntarily to Makati City Police as well as his firearm and IDs. | via Vince Lopez

📸: PNP/Screengrab
